tool.intro: Find out what’s in place for a small AI marketing pilot. Your answers stay on this page.
questions: Can you name one marketing task you repeat every week?
Choose one repeated task with a clear start and finish, such as drafting enquiry replies.
Do you know how long that task takes today?
Time a few runs before changing the process.
Do you have approved examples your team can work from?
Collect a few strong examples with personal details removed.
Does your team know which data can go into approved AI tools?
Agree on approved tools and what information must stay out.
Is someone responsible for checking AI drafts before they go live?
Assign a reviewer and give them a checklist for facts, tone and promises.
Can you run a small trial without touching live customer records?
Build a trial with synthetic examples and add difficult cases.
Have you picked a success measure beyond output volume?
Compare review time, errors or qualified enquiries with your baseline.
